findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.flowfeed.cc" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_latest_news, search_news, get_official_releases · Public sink: get_latest_news, search_news, get_official_releases.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_latest_news, search_news, get_official_releases · Public sink: get_latest_news, search_news, get_official_releases

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
